name: 14464-eaglespec-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=8, bounded at 320 requests / 900 s safety, warmup the first 25% by completion; `max-num-seqs: 8` matches it, so the steady-state batch is the eight in-flight requests.
workload: guidellm `json_file`, single turn, no prefix_buckets: `configs/data/gsm8k-eagle-turn1.jsonl`, 80 grade-school-maths word problems cycled 4 times to reach the 320-request bound. The Llama-3 chat template is already rendered into each `prompt` (wire length mean 66.8, min 33, p50 63, p90 97, max 130 tokens). Output is fixed at 256 tokens for every request (guidellm sets max_tokens=256 and ignore_eos=True, so generation continues past a natural stop); greedy, temperature 0.0.
purpose: A grade-school maths tutor solving short word problems with speculative drafting for eight concurrent students on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM 0.8.0rc1-era V0 AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction.
# The `speculative-*` keys below are this era's flat spelling -- the single `--speculative-config`
# argument does not exist yet, so do not "modernise" them against a later vLLM, and validate any
# edit to this file in the pinned engine's own venv.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct
speculative-model: abhigoyal/EAGLE-LLaMA3-Instruct-8B-vllm
num-speculative-tokens: 2
speculative-draft-tensor-parallel-size: 1

# 2048 on both sides: the draft checkpoint's own max_position_embeddings is 2048.
max-model-len: 2048
speculative-max-model-len: 2048
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# LOAD-BEARING, NOT A DEFAULT: the V0 default is 256. 8 makes the steady-state batch exactly the
# scenario's 8 closed-loop streams; raising it changes the operating point.
max-num-seqs: 8
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.80

# The V0 defaults at this commit, written down so a later default cannot drift them. Prefix
# caching must stay off: the request file is cycled, so with it on most of the run would prefill
# out of cache.
enable-chunked-prefill: false
enable-prefix-caching: false
dtype: bfloat16
